body:
Stacked on #7277 (shares `Cargo.lock` / `listener2-core/Cargo.toml` hunks).

## Summary
- Soniox and Deepgram accept no speaker count and never see voiceprints, so the remote channel of a Pro batch refine often carries more "speakers" than the meeting had people. On-device transcripts already get both signals through the local diarizer; hosted ones got neither.
- New `batch/consolidate.rs` post-pass, hosted-only (inverse of `is_local_batch`): per transcript channel, count distinct provider labels and derive the expected cap from `num_speakers`/`max_speakers` with the same per-channel shift local diarization uses. When labels exceed the cap or known voiceprints exist, resample to 16 kHz channel files (reusing the diarize helpers), embed each label's clean spans (`anlg_voiceprint::select_speaker_spans` + `anlg_embedding`), merge labels that uniquely match one known participant, then merge most-similar pairs until within the cap, and renumber by first appearance. Labels with no embeddable speech follow their nearest neighbour in time; with no embeddings at all the provider labels stand.
- Skips entirely, without decoding audio, when the count already fits and no voiceprints are known. The direct-mic channel of a stereo capture is never touched.
- `plugins/transcription` now loads `known_speakers` for every batch run instead of only local ones.
- `diarize.rs`: `plan_channel` split into `channel_audio` + `expected_speaker_cap` (the latter keeps a cap of 1, which the diarizer had no use for); `Heartbeat`, `MixedAudioSource` and the stereo test fixture are shared with the new module.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo test -p listener2-core -p tauri-plugin-transcription` — includes two real-audio tests on the `english_1` stereo fixture: a 3-way over-split remote speaker collapses to one label under a 1:1 hint, and on a downmixed transcript with `num_speakers=2` the two speaker0 labels merge while speaker1 keeps its own
- [x] `cargo clippy --locked -p listener2-core --lib --no-deps -- -D warnings` (the crate's test target has three pre-existing `bool_assert_comparison` failures in `lib.rs`, untouched)
- [ ] Pro batch refine on a 3+ remote-participant meeting: confirm `speaker_consolidation` metadata and that the remote channel no longer exceeds the attendee count
- [ ] Same meeting with a saved voiceprint for one attendee: confirm their fragments merge before the post-hoc assignment names them

title: Consolidate over-split speakers in hosted batch transcripts
